alcanada.name: Alcanada
alcanada.address: Carretera del Faro, s/n, 07400 Port d'Alcúdia

info.arrivalPoint: Drive in to the club using the address shown and go to the pro shop or reception to check in.
info.bringWater: A water bottle to top up at the fountains on the course.
info.hireBags: Hire clubs are TaylorMade Qi4D. You can carry the hire bags.
info.buggyTrolley: You can walk it if you are fit, but there are some big climbs to certain tees and long rides between holes. Buggies are allowed on the fairways when the weather permits. Buggies with GPS, electric trolleys and pull trolleys are available to hire.
info.proShopOpens: Reception and the pro shop open at 07:30.
info.firstTee: The first tee time is 08:00.
info.earlyTee: The pro shop, the driving range and the cafe bar are all open for the first tee times of the day.
info.rangeOpens: Balls are included in the green fee, and the pyramids are prepared when the course opens.
info.practiceFacilities: There is a Toptracer driving range with a covered practice area of 10 mats and an outdoor one of 10 mats, a natural-grass practice area in season when available, and a short game area.
info.foodBeforeRound: The restaurant opens at 08:00, some days a little earlier but not guaranteed. Terrace with lighthouse views.
info.water: There are water fountains out on the course, so bring a bottle and refill it. The Lighthouse Bar halfway house sits between the 9th and 10th holes for drinks, beer, sandwiches and tapas.
info.licence: €3 per person per day, paid at reception on check-in, unless you hold a Spanish federation licence.
info.dressCode: Collared shirts or golf mock-collar shirts; women may wear sleeveless golf shirts. No jeans, t-shirts, swimwear, leggings, tracksuits or cut-offs, on the course or the practice area.
info.shoes: Soft spikes are required: metal spikes are not allowed.
info.changingRooms: Changing rooms in the restored original estate building. Free lockers (take a €1 coin), free towels and shower products.
info.parking: Car park at the club, with EV charging points.
info.payment: Cards are accepted at the club.
info.flights: The club may pair players into groups of up to four.

info.arrivalPoint: Drive in to the club using the address shown and go to the pro shop or reception to check in.
info.bringWater: A water bottle. There is a free refill station at the clubhouse.
info.buggyTrolley: The course is hilly with long walks from green to tee, so a buggy is compulsory before 14:00 and walking is allowed from 14:00. Book the buggy with your tee time, as two players share one. Electric and push trolleys are also available.
info.proShopOpens: The pro shop is open every day 08:00-18:00.
info.firstTee: The first tee time is usually 08:00.
info.earlyTee: The pro shop and the driving range are open for the first tee times of the day.
info.rangeOpens: Range use is free with a green fee. Balls come from a card machine: €5 for 1 credit (about 40 balls), €20 for 5 credits, €35 for 10 and €60 for 20. TrackMan Range with 21 open and 7 covered bays.
info.practiceFacilities: The practice facilities are a few minutes’ buggy drive from the first tee: a chipping green, a short game pitching area and a putting green, as well as the driving range.
info.foodBeforeRound: Restaurante Campino (Italian, terrace over the 18th) open every day 09:00-23:00.
info.water: Halfway House straight after hole 8: Mallorcan tapas and cold drinks. Free water from the refill station at the clubhouse.
info.licence: €3 per person per day unless the player holds a Spanish federation licence. Can be added to the online booking, and each player fills in a short form at the pro shop before playing.
info.dressCode: Men: collared or crew-neck shirt tucked into the trousers at all times, golf trousers or shorts, and caps worn with the peak forward. No T-shirts, tank tops, jeans, tracksuits, cargo pants, three-quarter length trousers, sandals or sneakers. Ladies: collared or crew-neck shirt (sleeveless golf shirts are fine) and golf trousers or skirts of a sensible length. No T-shirts, blouses, tank tops, jeans, tracksuits, sandals, sneakers or heels.
info.shoes: Closed-heel golf shoes with soft spikes only. Sandals and sneakers are not allowed.
info.changingRooms: Changing rooms, showers and lockers are available.
info.parking: Easy parking right by the clubhouse.
info.payment: Cards are accepted at the club.
info.flights: The club may add other players to a group of fewer than four.

info.firstTee: The first starting time is 09:10.

info.rangeOpens: The driving range opens at 08:00 every day except Tuesday, when it opens at 09:00.

info.foodBeforeRound: The restaurant opens at 10:30. The pro shop has a coffee machine and a water refill.

info.licence: There is no separate daily licence charge.
info.dressCode: Collared shirts or golf mock-collar shirts. No jeans, t-shirts, swimwear, leggings, tracksuits or cut-offs on the course.
info.shoes: Soft spikes are mandatory.
info.changingRooms: Changing rooms and showers.
info.payment: Cards are accepted at the club.
info.flights: The club can advise for a specific day and time.

info.firstTee: The first tee time is usually 09:00.
info.practiceFacilities: There is a driving range, a putting green, a pitching green, a chipping green and a practice bunker.

info.water: Water and tees come with the buggy.
info.licence: €3 per person per day, unless you hold a Spanish federation licence.

info.shoes: Soft spikes only. Metal spikes are not allowed.

info.payment: Cards are accepted at the club.
info.flights: Tee times are for groups of four, so another player may book the same slot online.
info.rangeOpens: Range balls are €3 for a token of 38. Using the range without a green fee costs €10.

info.payment: Cards are accepted at the club.

maioris.name: Maioris
maioris.address: Camí de Cabo Blanco, Km 7, 07609 Llucmajor

info.arrivalPoint: Drive in to the club using the address shown and go to the pro shop or reception to check in.
info.bringWater: A water bottle. There are no fountains on the course, and water is sold in the pro shop, the restaurant and from vending machines on the course.
info.hireBags: Hire bags can be carried on foot, with or without a trolley.
info.buggyTrolley: You can walk it if you are reasonably fit, but the final holes include two significant climbs, so take a buggy if that worries you. Buggies, trolleys and electric trolleys are available, and buggies are not guaranteed in high season, so book ahead.
info.proShopOpens: Reception opens at 07:30 and the first tee time is 08:00.
info.firstTee: The first tee time is 08:00.
info.practiceFacilities: There is a driving range with grass and mat hitting areas, a large putting green, an all-grass chipping and pitching area with slopes, and a bunker practice area.
info.foodBeforeRound: The restaurant does not open until 10:00. There is a coffee machine and cold drinks at the club, and a small shopping centre nearby where you can have breakfast.
info.water: There are no water fountains on the course. Water is sold in the pro shop, the restaurant and from vending machines on the course.
info.licence: No daily licence or insurance charge.
info.dressCode: Collared shirts or golf mock-collar shirts. No jeans, t-shirts, swimwear, leggings, tracksuits or cut-offs on the course.
info.shoes: Soft spikes required.
info.changingRooms: Changing rooms on the clubhouse ground floor.
info.payment: Cards are accepted at the club. Buggies, trolleys and hire clubs are paid directly at the course.
info.flights: Another player can be added, but a single player rarely takes the fourth place. The club can try to reserve the spare place when you book.
info.arrivalNotes: An active golf licence is required. Under-14s must be with an adult. Book hire equipment with the tee time.
info.rangeOpens: Range tokens are €3 for 35 balls, or €25 for ten tokens. Using the range without a green fee costs €8.

restaurants.name: Na Capitana
restaurants.note: Healthy cuisine with a local touch.

info.arrivalPoint: Drive in to the club using the address shown and go to the pro shop or reception to check in.
info.bringWater: A water bottle. It is only nine holes with no halfway house, and Son Quint's clubhouse nearby has a refill station.
info.hireBags: Hire sets come in carry bags with double straps, so you can carry them or use a trolley.
info.rentalNotes: Return hired equipment in the condition you received it. Damage, loss or misuse can be charged to your card or hotel room. Buggy drivers must be 18 or over; only the designated driver may drive, with no more than two people seated inside. Follow the permitted routes and staff instructions. Do not drive under the influence of alcohol or drugs. Use the parking brake when stopped and switch off when unused. Read the full terms before signing: they include liability waivers and damage charges for buggies and clubs.
info.buggyTrolley: The course is short and easy to walk, so you do not need a buggy. There are no buggies on the pitch and putt, but trolleys are available.
info.proShopOpens: Winter (from 26 October): the course is open 07:00-18:30. Summer: 07:30-20:30.
info.firstTee: The earliest tee time bookable online is usually 07:40, the same as Son Quint.
info.earlyTee: On the first tee time of the day there is little or no time to use the range before you tee off. Early mornings can be cold with dew still down, so bring a jacket.
info.rangeOpens: Register at the pro shop before using the range.
info.practiceFacilities: The Son Quint driving range, chipping area and putting green are less than 100 metres away.
info.foodBeforeRound: The restaurant opens at 08:00, so it is not open before the earliest tee times. In winter (from 26 October) the kitchen only starts at 09:00, so there is no cooked breakfast before then.
info.water: There is no halfway house, as it is only nine holes. Son Quint's clubhouse is nearby and has a water refill station.
info.licence: €2 per person per day, unless you hold a Spanish federation licence. Register online before the day to skip the queue at the pro shop. You can pay online or at the pro shop.
info.dressCode: Casual: t-shirts and jeans are fine.
info.shoes: Golf shoes with soft spikes only. Metal spikes are not allowed.
info.changingRooms: Changing rooms and showers are shared with Son Quint.
info.payment: Cards are accepted at the club.
info.flights: Arabella can add other players to a group of fewer than four. If you would rather have the tee time to yourselves, ask me and I will confirm the supplement.
info.arrivalNotes: Juniors must show an official ID.

foodBeforeRound.summer: The restaurant opens at 08:00, so it is not open before the earliest tee times.
foodBeforeRound.winter: The restaurant opens at 08:00 and the kitchen at 09:00, so there is no cooked breakfast before a 09:00 start.

info.arrivalPoint: Drive in to the club using the address shown and go to the pro shop or reception to check in.
info.bringWater: A water bottle to top up at the water stations on the course.
info.hireBags: Hire sets come with carry bags.
info.buggyTrolley: You can walk it if you are reasonably fit, but there are a few climbs and two of the longest holes in Mallorca, so a buggy suits many players. Buggies, push trolleys and electric trolleys are available.

info.practiceFacilities: There is a driving range, a practice bunker, and pitching and putting greens.

info.licence: There is no extra licence charge on top of the green fee.
info.dressCode: Collared shirts or golf mock-collar shirts. No jeans, t-shirts, swimwear, leggings, tracksuits or cut-offs on the course.
info.shoes: Soft spikes only, no metal spikes.
info.changingRooms: Locker rooms and showers.
info.payment: Cards are accepted at the club.
info.flights: You can have a tee time with just three players, with no supplement.
info.rangeOpens: The practice range costs €7, plus €5 for a bucket of 50 balls.

info.foodBeforeRound: Na Capitana opens at 08:00 and has a breakfast menu. In winter (from 26 October) the restaurant closes at 18:00 and the kitchen at 17:30; in summer it is open until 19:30.
info.water: Every clubhouse has a water refill station for your own bottle. The halfway houses open at 10:30 with drinks, snacks and another refill station.
info.licence: €3 per person per day, unless you hold a Spanish federation licence. Register online before the day to skip the queue at the pro shop. You can pay online or at the pro shop.

info.payment: Cards are accepted at the club.

foodBeforeRound.summer: Na Capitana is open every day from 08:00 to 19:30 and has a breakfast menu.
foodBeforeRound.winter: Na Capitana opens at 08:00: restaurant 08:00-18:00, kitchen 08:00-17:30, with a breakfast menu.

restaurants.name: Na Capitana
restaurants.note: Healthy cuisine with a local touch.

info.firstTee: The first tee time is usually 07:40.
info.earlyTee: On the first tee time of the day there is little or no time to use the range before you tee off. Early mornings can be cold with dew still down, so bring a jacket.
info.rangeOpens: Register at the pro shop before using the range.
info.practiceFacilities: There is a separate driving range, a warm-up area beside the clubhouse, a chipping area and a putting green.
info.foodBeforeRound: The restaurant opens at 08:00, so it is not open before the earliest tee times. In winter (from 26 October) the kitchen only starts at 09:00, so there is no cooked breakfast before then.
info.water: Every clubhouse has a water refill station for your own bottle. The halfway houses open at 10:30 with drinks, snacks and another refill station.

info.shoes: Soft spikes only, no metal spikes.
info.changingRooms: Changing rooms and lockers are available.
info.parking: Car park at the club, with EV charging points.
info.payment: Cards are accepted at the club.
info.flights: Arabella can add other players to a group of fewer than four. If you would rather have the tee time to yourselves, ask me and I will confirm the supplement.
info.arrivalNotes: Juniors must show an official ID.

foodBeforeRound.summer: The restaurant opens at 08:00, so it is not open before the earliest tee times.
foodBeforeRound.winter: The restaurant opens at 08:00 and the kitchen at 09:00, so there is no cooked breakfast before a 09:00 start.

son_servera.name: Son Servera
son_servera.address: Carrer del Golf, 07559 Costa des Pins

info.arrivalPoint: Drive in to the club using the address shown and go to the pro shop or reception to check in.
info.hireBags: Hire bags are standard bags. You can carry them without a trolley, but the club recommends renting a manual trolley.
info.buggyTrolley: The course is flat and easy to walk, and a buggy is optional. Buggies, push trolleys and electric trolleys are available.
info.proShopOpens: Reception, the pro shop and the first tee time are all 08:00.
info.firstTee: The first tee time is 08:00.
info.earlyTee: There is no time to spare before the very first tee time.
info.rangeOpens: The driving range is closed on Wednesdays for mowing.
info.practiceFacilities: There is a driving range with 15 mats and a seasonal grass area, a putting green, two chipping areas and a practice bunker.
info.foodBeforeRound: The restaurant opens at 08:30, so it is not open for the earliest tee times. Costa de los Pinos has a terrace over the 18th and the sea.
info.licence: There is no separate daily licence charge.
info.dressCode: Appropriate golf clothing.
info.shoes: Soft spikes only. Metal spikes are not allowed.
info.changingRooms: Locker room in the clubhouse.
info.payment: Cards are accepted at the club.
info.flights: In high season tee times are organised in groups of four, so a fourth player may join a group of three.

son_termes.name: Son Termes
son_termes.address: Carretera de Santa Maria, Km 10, 07193 S'Esgleieta

info.arrivalPoint: Drive in to the club using the address shown and go to the pro shop or reception to check in.
info.bringWater: Enough water for the whole round. There are no fountains on the course.
info.hireBags: Hire bags have double straps, so you can carry them.
info.buggyTrolley: The terrain is hilly, with long walks from some greens to the next tee, so a buggy is recommended. The club sells buggies and electric trolleys only as a package with the green fee. Manual trolleys are available separately.
info.proShopOpens: The gates open at 08:00.
info.firstTee: The first available tee time is 08:20. The gates open at 08:00.
info.earlyTee: On Mondays the range does not open until 10:00, so there is no warm-up before an early tee time.
info.rangeOpens: The driving range opens at 08:00 from Tuesday to Sunday, and at 10:00 on Mondays.
info.practiceFacilities: There is a small driving range with grass and mat hitting areas and a bunker, a chipping green and a putting green.
info.foodBeforeRound: The restaurant opens at 10:00. Terrace with views over Palma, the cathedral and the sea.
info.water: There are no water fountains out on the course, so bring enough water with you.
info.licence: No daily licence charge.
info.dressCode: Collared shirts or golf mock-collar shirts. No jeans, t-shirts, swimwear, leggings, tracksuits or cut-offs on the course.
info.shoes: Soft spikes only. Metal spikes are not allowed.
info.changingRooms: Locker rooms.
info.parking: Easy parking right by the clubhouse.
info.payment: Cards are accepted at the club.
info.flights: The club may add other players to a group of fewer than four.

info.arrivalPoint: Drive in to the club using the address shown and go to the pro shop or reception to check in.
info.bringWater: No need to bring water. Tees and water are provided.
info.hireBags: Hire bags can be carried, so you do not need a trolley.
info.buggyTrolley: It is not very hilly and easy to walk, and buggies are allowed on the fairways when the weather permits. Buggies, manual trolleys and electric trolleys are available.
info.proShopOpens: The course and driving range are open 08:00-20:00.
info.firstTee: Tee times are currently from 07:40, and the time varies with the date.
info.earlyTee: For an early tee time the pro shop may not have opened when you arrive. Wait for reception, then check in and collect your buggy before you tee off, so allow time for this.
info.practiceFacilities: There is a grass driving range with 40 stations and 7 target greens, two putting greens, two chipping greens, and two pitching and approach areas with practice bunkers.
info.foodBeforeRound: The restaurant is open every day 08:30-20:00. Breakfast is served 10:00-11:30, then baguettes only until 12:00, and the kitchen runs 12:00-19:00.
info.water: Tees and water are provided.
info.licence: €3 per person per day, unless you hold a Spanish federation licence.
info.dressCode: Collared shirts, tailored shorts or trousers and golf shoes. No jeans.
info.shoes: Golf shoes with soft spikes. Metal spikes are not allowed.
info.changingRooms: Changing room with lockers (electronic lockers reset daily) and showers.
info.parking: Easy parking right by the clubhouse.
info.payment: Cards are accepted at the club.
info.flights: Another player may book the same tee time, though this is uncommon for a group of three. To have the course to yourselves you pay for four green fees.
info.arrivalNotes: Official handicap required: 28 men, 34 ladies. Dogs on a lead allowed on the course and terrace.
info.rangeOpens: Range balls are not included: a token of 30 balls costs €5.

t_golf_palma.name: T Golf Palma
t_golf_palma.address: Camí Vell de Sineu, Km 10, 07198 Palma

info.arrivalPoint: Drive in to the club using the address shown and go to the pro shop or reception to check in.
info.bringWater: A water bottle. The halfway house is open 11:00 to 16:00 in peak season, and there is a drinks cart on the course.
info.hireBags: Hire bags can be carried, so you do not need a trolley.
info.buggyTrolley: It is gently undulating and easy to walk, and there are buggy paths. Buggies can go onto the fairways when the weather permits. Buggies, manual trolleys and electric trolleys are available.
info.proShopOpens: The course is open from 07:30 to 20:00 in summer and 08:00 to 18:00 in winter.
info.firstTee: Tee times are currently from 07:40, and the time varies with the date.
info.earlyTee: An early group will find no coffee, and the range does not open until 08:00.
info.rangeOpens: The driving range is open 08:00-18:00, and closes at 16:00 on Tuesdays. The range, pitching and putting areas are included with a 9 or 18-hole green fee on the same day, otherwise the practice fee is €15 per person. Range balls are not included: a token of 30 Wilson Premium balls costs €5.
info.practiceFacilities: There is a 42-bay driving range with 14 covered bays, putting greens and a large short game area.
info.foodBeforeRound: Restaurant opens 08:30 (summer 08:30-20:00, winter 08:30-19:00); the kitchen runs 11:00-19:00 in summer, 11:00-17:45 in winter. Nothing is open before 08:30.
info.water: Halfway house open 11:00-16:00 in peak season. From mid-March there is a mandatory 10-minute stop at the halfway. Drinks cart on the course.
info.licence: €3 per person per day, unless you hold a Spanish federation licence.
info.dressCode: Collared shirts, tailored shorts or trousers and golf shoes are required. No jeans.
info.shoes: Golf shoes are required.
info.changingRooms: Locker room with heated floors, air conditioning, showers and lockers.
info.payment: Cards are accepted at the club.
info.flights: Another player may book the same tee time, though this is uncommon for a group of three. To have the course to yourselves you pay for four green fees.
info.arrivalNotes: Official handicap required: 28 men, 34 ladies. Dogs on a lead are allowed on the course and terrace. Keep an eye on your belongings, as the club warns of thefts at golf courses on the island.

vall_dor.name: Vall d'Or
vall_dor.address: Ctra Cala d'Or - Portocolom, Km 7,7, 07669 Felanitx

info.arrivalPoint: Drive in to the club using the address shown and go to the pro shop or reception to check in.
info.bringWater: Your own water. There is no drinkable water on the course, and bottles are sold at the restaurant.
info.hireBags: Hire sets are for use with a buggy or a manual or electric trolley only, not for carrying.
info.buggyTrolley: The course is hilly, so a buggy is recommended, though you can walk it if you are fit. Buggies, trolleys and electric trolleys are available.
info.proShopOpens: Reception and the pro shop open at 07:30.
info.firstTee: The first tee time is 08:00.
info.practiceFacilities: There is a driving range with 18 teeing areas and sand bunkers, putting greens and a chipping green.
info.foodBeforeRound: Everything is open from 07:30, before the 08:00 first tee time. Maxime Restaurant has a terrace with sea and course views, and a Friday barbecue with live music from May to October.
info.water: There is no drinkable water on the course. Bottles are sold at the restaurant, or bring your own.
info.licence: No daily licence charge. A golf licence and handicap are enough.
info.dressCode: Men: shirts with a collar and sleeves. Ladies: a top without a collar needs sleeves, a sleeveless top needs a collar. Tailored trousers or shorts; skirts or shorts for ladies. No denim, tracksuits, cargo, drawstring or gym shorts.
info.shoes: Golf shoes or flat-soled trainers. No street shoes or sandals.
info.changingRooms: Spacious changing rooms with individual showers, towels and lockers.
info.payment: Cards are accepted at the club.
info.flights: The club cannot guarantee that a group of three plays alone, especially in high season. The only way to be sure is to pay for the whole flight.
info.arrivalNotes: The course is open every day of the year.
info.rangeOpens: A basket of range balls is €4. A practice-only green fee is €12.
